meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time by default 15 minutes succeeds

plan.title: Increase RFQ Submission Time by 15 Minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where submission time can be extended.
Open Settings, choose the 15-minute Increase Event Time option, confirm it, and verify the end time moves 15 minutes later.
Assert the expected success confirmation after the extension is saved.
